headline: AVENIR GLOBAL Acquires Marker Collective to Expand AI and Communications Capabilities
summary: Montreal-based AVENIR GLOBAL has acquired Marker Collective, adding three communications agencies and a proprietary AI platform to its portfolio. The deal positions the firm among the world's 15 largest communications companies.
why: AVENIR GLOBAL is a private holding company managing a portfolio of specialist communications firms. Acquisitions in the professional services sector are often used to scale market share and integrate new technology stacks like AI.

impacts.name: AVENIR GLOBAL
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's service offerings and market footprint.
